scope: Empty result tables are a prospective work plan, not completed experiments or preregistration.
missing: null means not measured; it is never a zero, an abstention, or task-inapplicable.
sourceUnit: independent source object or source family; all derivatives remain in one cluster
freezeBeforeCalls: licensed actual source assets and exclusions against cumulative exposure register
model revision, provider, prompt, images, decoder, output budget and tool budget
source selection hash, stratum weights, primary endpoints and analysis source hashes
minimum pair coverage, missing-data policy, multiplicity and precision plan
cost upper bound checked against the existing cumulative campaign ledger

tables.title: Independent confirmation: task success (%)
tables.design: All models share new source groups. Report ordinary RGB+BOM reconstruction/completion/repair separately from symbolic relations/edits/plans and constraint generation. Catalog recognition has a separate type-cluster denominator. Cells require estimate, 95% interval and actual source count.

tables.title: Paired information and representation controls
tables.design: Repeat separately for each model on identical sources. Exact hidden-structure success is comparable only where that information is disclosed; also report the ordinary surface criterion for every arm. Candidate lists add information, so local output versus candidate output is not a pure output-length intervention. Relative offsets remain in global axes.

tables.title: Candidate invariance on independent sources
tables.design: Per model, counterbalance correct labels and request timing. Compare actual selected poses. Primary D=mismatch(original,permuted)-mismatch(original,repeat); report complete-pair estimate and worst-case missing-pair bounds. Fit debiasing on development sources only. Random choice has analytic accuracy 1/K, not a measured row.

tables.title: Difficulty and nuisance controls
tables.design: Report per task/model; cross piece count with policy and declared occlusion rather than interpreting marginal size as a causal factor. Source prefixes remain paired. Camera/color perturbations use versioned renders; human observability and latent structural ambiguity are separate quantities.

tables.title: External-domain evaluation and specialized baselines
tables.design: No external structure assets are integrated yet. First audit licenses, unsupported part rejection, units and connector mappings. Run specialized methods only on their supported tasks with matching inputs; original-paper scores are never copied into the BrickAtlas columns. Preserve source families and report import rejection.

tables.title: Human calibration of automatic acceptance
tables.design: At least two real independent blinded reviewers; retain accept/reject/uncertain and third-person adjudication. False acceptance denominator is human-rejected outputs; false rejection denominator is human-accepted outputs. Report numerator/denominator, source-cluster intervals, reviewer agreement and unresolved coverage. A review interface is not a completed review.

tables.title: Effective training and independent replication
tables.design: New study only, not missing entries of the completed ten-job pilot. Freeze checkpoint and splits, demonstrate an effective task baseline, match answer-token budget and separately report image/input tokens, wall time and seeds. Leave-task-out improvement is measured against a compute-accounted single-task control, not NLL alone.
